dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: A gradual, symmetrical linear narrowing of the 2D body mass from the wide mid-section toward the visible posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth lateral margins with minimal deviation; a slight asymmetrical bulge is visible on the anterior-left margin relative to the right.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Off-white to light-grey median pixel intensity across the dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse greyish clusters are distributed along the posterior dorsal ridge and visible flanks.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Gradient boundaries between the base pigmentation and darker posterior variations are highly diffuse and gradual.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: One prominent, high-contrast dark circular feature located on the anterior dorsal midline, with a smaller, secondary dark spot situated immediately to its left.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A clearly defined longitudinal dorsal ridge is visible with no significant topological depressions or unnatural geometric deformations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint, longitudinal linear markings, resembling superficial scratches or rake marks, are visible on the mid-dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, isolated high-contrast dark circular point on the anterior dorsal surface.
